amendment: docs/SPEC.md, D7 canonical amendment (owner, 2026-09-11) plus the twelve Fable addenda

dataset.label: HISTORICAL_MARKET
dataset.note: the same file D5/D6 hashed; the amendment forbids replacing it with a newly downloaded rolling sample

oih_excluded_because: amendment section 1: the previously reported availability problem, not its returns. OIH stays in data/market/ and in the system, untouched.

WARMUP.note: feature initialisation and horizon calibration only; no brain is run, no DECISION event is written, no reinforcement occurs

LEARNING.note: the complete sequential decision/outcome/learning loop at H*

FROZEN.note: two branches, TRAINED and REFERENCE; learning and forgetting off; end checkpoint hash must equal start hash

horizon_rule.statistic: A(H) = median across qualifying WARMUP sessions of [median across the session's common origins of abs(g(t,H))]
horizon_rule.g: gross fixed-hold long return in basis points at the reference (unslipped) opens, before costs, under the existing entry/exit convention, inside one session
horizon_rule.selection: smallest H in H_SET with A(H) >= multiple * C
horizon_rule.cost_measurement: C is measured by one flat-price round trip through flytrade.historical.HistoricalExecution at the configured notional; the measured figure governs and is never inferred from rounded report text

warmup_qualification.ohlcv: validated and deduplicated by flytrade.historical.parse_kibot_minute, which rejects rather than repairs
warmup_qualification.basis: data quality only, never volatility, profitability or reward balance
warmup_qualification.on_failure: report it; do not extend dates, relax criteria or substitute instruments

clean_reference_checkpoint.note: the declared clean reference; not hist-003 and not an odour-trained demonstration checkpoint

readout.aggregation: mean of per-neuron rates over the k replicates, decoder applied once

LEARNING.one_schedule_only: one preregistered training seed schedule for this wave; no search over training seeds and no retained winner

FROZEN.why: amendment section 6: seeds must not depend on the checkpoint's weight digest, so a difference between branches is a difference in weights and not in noise

execution.cost_basis: per execution (charged on the entry and again on the exit)
execution.horizon_source: the registered horizon artifact, selected by the WARMUP calibration; deliberately NOT a field of this file
execution.fill_rule: open of the first available regular-session bar with bar_start >= bar_end(decision), same session
execution.settlement_rule: open of the first available bar with bar_start >= fill.bar_start + H*, same session
execution.entry_eligibility: bar_end(t) + 1 market minute + H* <= 16:00 on the same session
execution.session_close_rule: a position still open at its instrument's last available bar of the session closes at that bar's close, flagged SESSION_CLOSE_FILL
execution.sequencing_guard: an entry may not fill before the previous exit filled
execution.no_invented_fills: a due fill or settlement without a valid price is a recorded Rejection, never a fabricated price and never a dropped episode
execution.reconciliation: gross_reference_pnl - fees - slippage = net_pnl, residual must be 0 to 1e-6
execution.unchanged: costs, sizing, delay, long-only inventory and session-boundary rules are exactly D5/D6's; the permitted behavioural change in this wave is the fixed H alone

evaluation.probe: the ordinary per-round readout, extracted from the two FROZEN event logs after both branches finished; no runtime hook and no second neural pass
evaluation.score: DECISION.valence_hz, the decoder's continuous centred V, before thresholding and before inventory constraints
evaluation.grid_rule: observation status OK and (m + 1) + delay + H* <= 390, computed from the session calendar and the price file before either event log is opened
evaluation.label: G(t) = net return on notional of a hypothetical fixed-notional long entered under the existing fill convention and held H* market minutes, including unchanged costs; Y(t) = 1 when G(t) > 0
evaluation.label_unavailable: UNAVAILABLE_LABEL, counted; never invented and never replaced by a loss
evaluation.primary_metric: DELTA_AUC = mean across qualifying sessions of [AUC_TRAINED - AUC_REFERENCE]
evaluation.auc: pairwise, ties at 0.5 credit; a one-class session is undefined, not 0.5
evaluation.coverage_rule: if either branch or the paired set covers less than 95% of otherwise label-available probes, the aggregate inference is marked coverage-limited/inconclusive
evaluation.bootstrap_seed_label: sha256('flytrade-d7-bootstrap-1')[:4] as a big-endian unsigned integer
evaluation.bootstrap_unit: whole qualifying sessions, both branches kept paired
evaluation.top_fraction_ties: fractional weighting; never broken by a future label or by time order
evaluation.top_fraction_fixed: 0.20 is fixed and no percentile is searched over
conclusions: A: context-discrimination evidence in this experiment
B: suppression without demonstrated discrimination improvement
evaluation.positive_delta_alone_insufficient: if TRAINED remains at or below chance-level ranking

compute_budget.reduction_rule: if the pre-run estimate exceeds 90 minutes, LEARNING is run on its last N sessions only, N the largest integer for which the total falls under 90 minutes; the dropped sessions are named in the report; WARMUP and FROZEN are never shortened; dates are never shifted; k is never reduced

runs.retry_rule: a retry after a software correction gets a new run id; the failed run's directory and its explanation are kept and reported
runs.discard_rule: a run started before the commit of this file is discarded and said to be discarded; likewise a run that read a substituted dataset, a horizon not taken from registered-horizon-artifact, or whose frozen-branch checkpoint hash moved

frozen_and_not_decided_by_this_run: the encoder mapping, normalisation algorithm and bounds
the decoder formula and its sign
THETA_SD = 1.0 and the stored k = 8 baseline artifact
one normalised learning update per settled outcome
long-only inventory-aware execution, sizing, fees and modelled slippage
